scope: P6: FlightControls capture-loss ownership and physical release gate

environment.input: Trusted touch PointerEvents dispatched with Chromium CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent
environment.renderer: No WebGL game renderer; /input-probe imports src/input.ts in a small static fixture

covers: Two simultaneous trusted touch pointers acquired real browser pointer capture on the steering surface and Fire button.
After pointerup plus trusted implicit lostpointercapture for Fire, steering remains active and the release gate remains open until steering lifts.
The reverse ordering preserves a held Fire input when steering pointerup is followed by trusted implicit lostpointercapture.
Releasing an active Loop and steering capture through releasePointerCapture produces trusted lostpointercapture, clears the owning action, and requires physical touchEnd before acknowledgement.
Button implicit capture loss does not cancel a live steering pointer.
Steering implicit capture loss does not cancel a live Fire pointer.
Capture loss while a button or steering pointer is still owned sets the gate and awaits physical release.

limits: Chromium simulated touch input is not physical-device Safari or mobile GPU validation.
This record covers pointer capture and release only; other P6 browser checks and final full-suite results are recorded separately.
